message:
Here's the good news: the local check found no failures, so the design itself is consistent and nothing broke. It's marked "blocked" because none of the supported building blocks covers the GCP parts we need. Today's typed contracts only cover AWS pipelines and private object storage on GCP. So Pub/Sub, the DLP redaction service on Cloud Run, BigQuery evidence and the triage orchestrator still need native implementations, which is product engineering work. This report can serve as the reproducer (artifact 561a4d9d…). The three existing sources also need a plan for referencing them.

I won't change the diagram to turn these checks green, because the only "supported" option would be to shrink the project down to storage, and you've ruled that out. I've also left the alert-to-case path as it is, since the analyst queue is already the approval step and the triage service has no permission to take action. One thing to note: the scripted model in these tests says nothing about triage quality.

For the existing approved logs and asset inventory, should we import them from a Google Cloud project you already have, or treat them as synthetic fixtures for this qualification? That choice decides whether we need a project ID and permissions, or just test data.
